Name: Fair Farm
Author: LordSnowFox
Description:
This map was designed for 16 players to play together and everyone is able to have their own space to build sorta like four corners but with alot more space.
The map mod takes the place of the standard farm map, best not to load unmodded versions of saves of the standard map while this map is installed.
this mod dose tend to conflict with many cosmetic mods due to some custom textures being made for the map and my lack of know how on how to make things work with others without goofin things up.
the greenhouse interior was also expanded inside to compensate for the additional farmers playing.
----EVERYONE PLAYING NEEDS THE MOD TO PLAY TOGETHER----

Using Elle's Seasonal Buildings for the structures look in the pics.
